name: STAR MIND
principles: local-first
one STAR Core
same official SQLite database
legacy routing preserved
auditable artifacts instead of hidden chain-of-thought
no autonomous code modification
no invented certainty
provenance before growth counters
model is not STAR
body is not STAR
thinking is not acting
curiosity is not authorization
inference is not fact
cognitive autonomy is not operational autonomy
knowledge keeps provenance, evidence, confidence, uncertainty and temporal validity
canonical status requires evidence and remains revisable
canonical knowledge is grounded in canonical epistemic claims
indexes and cache accelerate access but are never sources of truth
observed physical scene state is transient and is not canonical knowledge by itself
physical predictions are inference and never operational authorization
scientific physics is reused rather than duplicated by the world model
scientific theories and models remain revisable and are not silently collapsed into facts
scientific references never become canonical knowledge without the BLOCO 2 and BLOCO 3 gates
quantitative science preserves units, uncertainty, assumptions and domain of validity
scientific taxonomies and relations reuse the official Knowledge Graph instead of creating a parallel graph
biological and human-body knowledge never becomes automatic diagnosis
body signals and physiological needs are context and are not silently converted into disease labels
BLOCO 6 does not automatically select treatments or create personal health profiles
psychological knowledge never turns an isolated behavior into diagnosis, stable trait, intention or certainty
expressions and social signals remain context-dependent observations rather than mind-reading evidence
BLOCO 7 preserves alternative interpretations, exceptions and uncertainty
BLOCO 7 does not automatically create personal psychological profiles or mental-disorder labels
linguistic knowledge is distinct from operational locale and translation support
form, gesture, voice, pause or silence alone never proves a unique meaning or intention
irony, sarcasm, humor and indirect communication remain context-dependent interpretations
BLOCO 8 reuses the official LanguageManager instead of creating a parallel translation runtime
societies and cultures are not fixed homogeneous essences; internal diversity, history and region remain explicit
group membership never determines an individual's trait, belief, behavior or intention
political description does not imply endorsement and contested social claims preserve competing perspectives and evidence
religious belief, mythology and law preserve their own categories plus historical, regional and jurisdictional context
BLOCO 9 reuses multidisciplinary History, Geography, Psychology/Sociology and Philosophy instead of duplicating them
age, disability, role or environment never determine capacity, consent, privacy or responsibility by themselves
human-context interpretation preserves accessibility, supported autonomy, boundaries and uncertainty
crisis or emergency raises safety salience but never grants unrestricted operational authorization
BLOCO 10 reuses BLOCO 6, 7, 8 and 9 instead of duplicating human development, psychology, language or society/culture
everyday and technical knowledge never implies live state, operational access or authorization by itself
software, hardware, networks and infrastructure preserve platform, version, configuration, current-source and uncertainty context when relevant
BLOCO 11 reuses physical, scientific, human-context and multidisciplinary technical knowledge instead of duplicating computing, IT or engineering engines
SELF MODEL describes STAR from official sources but is not an authority to redefine identity or fundamental rules
identity remains sourced from core.star_identity.py and release/version remains sourced from STAR_MANIFEST.json
capability, availability, permission and safety are distinct; operational permissions use default deny unless explicitly represented
self history and experiences require auditable sources and are never fabricated to fill gaps
unknown or unavailable self-state, device, resource and capability information remains explicit instead of being invented
memory is contextual evidence and never becomes fact merely because it was stored or recalled
working memory is bounded and transient by default; persistence requires an explicit memory write
memory consolidation preserves source memories and records derivation instead of silently overwriting history
autobiographical memory and experiences require auditable source/reference and are never fabricated for continuity
people memory does not infer sensitive attributes automatically and memory retrieval never grants operational authorization
attention and salience rank what to analyze first but do not determine truth or operational authority
BLOCO 14 reuses BLOCO 13 working memory and core.state.StarState instead of creating parallel attention state
candidate selection is bounded/top-k and never requires loading the billion-address logical space simultaneously
risk and urgency may raise cognitive priority but never grant permission or bypass safety
WORLD, HUMAN, SOCIAL, SELF and SITUATION models are cooperating views of one STAR and reuse BLOCO 1 CognitiveModels instead of creating parallel frames
internal models reference shared knowledge, memory and state by provenance/relations instead of indiscriminately copying source datasets
SITUATION MODEL integrates the current bounded context and remains temporary, revisable and non-authorizing
each BLOCO 15 model has 1B logical address capacity while the five-model block has 5B total logical capacity on-demand
social inference remains hypothesis/context and never becomes fact merely from behavior or social signals
intention, deception, lie, secrecy, trust and reputation preserve alternative explanations and uncertainty
functional empathy supports perspective-taking but is not mind reading
trust, reputation, persuasion, urgency or social salience never grant operational permission
affect and adaptive personality remain distinct from the official STAR identity and fundamental values
persistent personality is represented in audited memory/history rather than existing only as a prompt
personality adaptation is bounded, append-only and linked to auditable experiences; previous states remain recoverable
preferences, style, confidence, familiarity and affect never grant operational permission
derived conclusions remain inference/hypothesis until independently verified and never rewrite source facts
simulation and counterfactual worlds remain separate from observations and historical memory
prediction preserves uncertainty and prediction error preserves both predicted and observed values
reasoning over large knowledge spaces uses bounded attention/context selection rather than loading all addressable contents
planning and cognitive decision remain distinct from operational execution
recommendation, priority, simulation and selected option never grant permission
B19 reuses the official CognitiveSuite planner and B18 simulation/risk instead of creating parallel engines
large planning spaces are handled through bounded context/option selection rather than loading all logical contents
metacognition distinguishes knowledge, belief, inference and unknown states instead of collapsing them
confidence scores do not become truth and contradictions remain visible until reviewed
need for research never grants network permission and need for questioning does not automatically block best-effort reasoning
B20 reuses CognitiveSuite.metacognition and bounded B14 attention rather than creating a parallel metacognitive engine
continuous learning preserves source, reference, confidence, consistency and previous versions
experience and generalization remain revisable and do not become canonical facts automatically
B21 may adapt memory, strategy and bounded personality state but has no unrestricted authority to modify central code
prediction error drives review without rewriting predicted or observed history
knowledge integration means updating model relations and active representations, not merely storing or copying data
B22 reuses the five B15 model frames and shared knowledge graph; no parallel world/human/social/self/situation models
noncanonical knowledge never becomes a model fact silently and SELF integration cannot redefine identity or permissions
Situation Model integration remains temporary/revisable and preserves the original knowledge item and provenance
Global Cognitive Workspace keeps a bounded active set rather than loading the logical knowledge space
B23 integrates Perception/Salience/Attention/Memory/Knowledge/Language/Planning/Executive/Self/Situation by reference
workspace activation and broadcast never execute actions or grant permissions
perception remains explicitly unavailable until a real provider is attached
B24 Mind Loop orchestrates existing cognition instead of duplicating memory, models, reasoning or planning
each Mind Loop cycle retrieves only bounded active context through B23/B14 rather than scanning logical 1B spaces
the ACTION stage evaluates operational eligibility but never executes tools or devices
RESULT/EXPERIENCE/LEARNING require observed and auditable input; the loop never fabricates outcomes to complete a cycle

foundational_catalog.truthfulness_note: 1B are deterministic operational representations of principles, rules, states, limits and combinations; not 1B independently researched facts

block_1_foundations.operational_rule: cognition never grants operational permission by itself

block_2_epistemics.canonical_policy: CANONICAL requires VERIFIED fact, explicit provenance, supporting evidence, calibrated confidence, acceptable uncertainty, compatible temporal validity and no open contradiction
block_2_epistemics.knowledge_ingestion: new daily-growth facts keep legacy counters and are also registered idempotently as DISCOVERED epistemic records

epistemic_catalog.truthfulness_note: 1B is an operational traceability space, not 1B independently researched facts or preloaded database rows

block_3_universal_knowledge.canonical_policy: a universal canonical object requires a BLOCO 2 claim in CANONICAL state and never promotes DISCOVERED/QUARANTINED/VERIFIED knowledge silently

indexing.cache: bounded in-memory LRU/TTL with invalidation on writes

block_3_universal_knowledge.deduplication: stable identity from namespace + knowledge type + normalized canonical label; duplicate canonical registrations reuse the same object and link additional claims

namespace_capacity.truthfulness_note: B01-B14 each expose a 1B logical block space (14B total); B15 exposes five 1B model subspaces (5B); therefore the integrated architecture represents 19B logical addresses, never 19B preloaded rows/facts

block_4_physical_world.database: star.db through BLOCO 3 for materialized canonical knowledge

world_state.object_permanence: loss of observation does not imply nonexistence; hidden objects persist with reduced state confidence until explicit evidence of removal/destruction/transformation

physical_catalog.truthfulness_note: 1B are addressable physical scenarios/schemas across object-material-property-state-environment-action-consequence-risk, not 1B independently researched scientific facts

block_5_scientific_foundations.database: star.db through BLOCO 3 for materialized canonical knowledge
block_5_scientific_foundations.knowledge_graph_taxonomy: Ciência -> domínio -> ramo -> subramo; scientific canonical knowledge is linked to its branch in the same shared graph
block_5_scientific_foundations.canonical_policy: scientific references, hypotheses, theories, models and provider answers are never auto-promoted; persistent canonical scientific knowledge requires the existing BLOCO 2 CANONICAL fact gate and BLOCO 3 promotion
block_5_scientific_foundations.quantitative_policy: preserve units, dimensional checks, uncertainty, assumptions, validity domain, evidence and source trace when applicable

scientific_catalog.truthfulness_note: 1B are deterministic addressable scientific representations across taxonomy, method, evidence, representation, application and verification axes; not 1B independently researched facts

block_6_human_life.database: star.db through BLOCO 3 for materialized canonical knowledge

reuse.scientific_foundation: BLOCO 5 ScientificFoundations and its Biology references

block_6_human_life.knowledge_graph_taxonomy: Vida, Corpo e Necessidades Humanas -> domínio -> ramo -> subtema, linked as a specialization of BLOCO 5 Biology in the same shared graph
block_6_human_life.canonical_policy: general human-biology knowledge may be persisted only after the existing BLOCO 2 CANONICAL fact gate and BLOCO 3 promotion; provider answers and body signals are never auto-canonicalized
block_6_human_life.needs_policy: sleep, hunger, thirst, pain, fatigue, nutrition, hygiene, breathing, temperature and recovery may be contextualized physiologically, but never converted automatically into disease candidates or treatment

human_life_catalog.truthfulness_note: 1B are deterministic addressable representations of general life, body, physiology and human-needs knowledge; not 1B independent medical facts, diagnoses or personal health records

block_7_human_psychology.database: star.db through BLOCO 3 for materialized canonical knowledge

reuse.biological_context: BLOCO 6 HumanLifeFoundations linked without reducing psychology to biology

block_7_human_psychology.knowledge_graph_taxonomy: Mente Humana e Psicologia -> domínio -> ramo -> subtema; root is related to BLOCO 6 human-life taxonomy and canonical B07 knowledge is linked to its branch in the same shared graph
block_7_human_psychology.canonical_policy: general psychology knowledge may persist only after the BLOCO 2 CANONICAL fact gate and BLOCO 3 promotion; observations, expressions, provider answers and inferred intentions are never auto-canonicalized as facts about a person

interpretation_policy.rule: COMPORTAMENTO ISOLADO ≠ DIAGNÓSTICO, TRAÇO ESTÁVEL, INTENÇÃO OU CERTEZA

block_7_human_psychology.behavior_interpretation: returns epistemic inference with underdetermined certainty, multiple plausible interpretations, exceptions, missing context and no diagnosis/personality/intention conclusion

psychology_catalog.truthfulness_note: 1B are deterministic addressable representations across psychological topics, contexts, perspectives, evidence modes, timescales, confidence bands and representations; not 1B diagnoses, personal profiles, inferred intentions or independently researched facts

block_8_language_communication.database: star.db through BLOCO 3 for materialized canonical knowledge
block_8_language_communication.future_languages: extensible; future languages are knowledge/runtime additions, not silently claimed as already operational

reuse.psychological_context: BLOCO 7 HumanPsychologyFoundations linked for communication context without reducing language to psychology

runtime_truthfulness.rule: linguistic knowledge in B08 does not imply complete UI/translation/runtime support

block_8_language_communication.knowledge_graph_taxonomy: Linguagem e Comunicação -> domínio -> ramo -> subtema; root is related to BLOCO 7 psychology context and canonical B08 knowledge is linked to its branch in the same shared graph
block_8_language_communication.canonical_policy: general linguistic/communication knowledge may persist only after the BLOCO 2 CANONICAL fact gate and BLOCO 3 promotion; translated surfaces, gestures, prosody, silence and inferred intentions are never auto-canonicalized as unique meanings or personal intent facts

interpretation_policy.rule: FORMA OU SINAL ISOLADO ≠ SIGNIFICADO ÚNICO, INTENÇÃO OU CERTEZA

language_communication_catalog.truthfulness_note: 1B are deterministic addressable representations across language, dialect, context, intention, register, culture, meaning, structure and situation; not 1B independent translations, utterances or researched facts

block_9_society_culture.database: star.db through BLOCO 3 for materialized canonical knowledge
block_9_society_culture.coverage_scope: societies, eras, regions, systems, concepts, relations and subtopics through deterministic addressable schemas; not exhaustive preloaded claims about every human group

reuse.human_context: BLOCO 7 HumanPsychologyFoundations linked contextually without reducing society to psychology
reuse.language_culture_context: BLOCO 8 LanguageCommunicationFoundations linked contextually without reducing culture to language

block_9_society_culture.knowledge_graph_taxonomy: Sociedade e Cultura -> domínio -> ramo -> subtema; root is related to BLOCO 7 and BLOCO 8 roots and canonical B09 knowledge is linked to its branch in the same shared graph
block_9_society_culture.canonical_policy: general social/cultural knowledge may persist only after the BLOCO 2 CANONICAL fact gate and BLOCO 3 promotion; provider answers and contextual social interpretations are never auto-canonicalized

interpretation_policy.rule: SOCIEDADE OU CULTURA ≠ ESSÊNCIA FIXA; CONTEXTO, ÉPOCA, REGIÃO, FONTES E PERSPECTIVAS DEVEM SER PRESERVADOS

society_culture_catalog.truthfulness_note: 1B are deterministic addressable sociocultural representations across society, era, region, system, relation and perspective; not 1B independent facts, group profiles or universal claims

block_10_human_contexts.database: star.db through BLOCO 3 for materialized canonical knowledge
block_10_human_contexts.knowledge_graph_taxonomy: Contextos Humanos Específicos -> domínio -> ramo -> subtema; root contextualizes B06-B09 roots in the same shared graph
block_10_human_contexts.canonical_policy: contextual knowledge may persist only after the BLOCO 2 CANONICAL fact gate and BLOCO 3 promotion; situational inference never becomes action authorization automatically

interpretation_policy.rule: IDADE, DEFICIÊNCIA, PAPEL OU AMBIENTE NÃO DETERMINAM SOZINHOS CAPACIDADE, NECESSIDADE, CONSENTIMENTO, PRIVACIDADE OU RESPONSABILIDADE

human_context_catalog.truthfulness_note: 1B are deterministic addressable human-context representations across person, age, environment, relation, need, risk, norm, culture and context; not 1B personal profiles, diagnoses or universal rules

block_11_everyday_technology.database: star.db through BLOCO 3 for materialized canonical knowledge

reuse.multidisciplinary: existing engineering, geography, mechanics, computing and IT subjects loaded lazily

block_11_everyday_technology.knowledge_graph_taxonomy: Mundo Cotidiano e Tecnológico -> domínio -> ramo -> subtema; canonical B11 knowledge is linked to its branch in the same shared graph
block_11_everyday_technology.canonical_policy: technical references and situational interpretations are never auto-promoted; persistent B11 knowledge requires the BLOCO 2 CANONICAL fact gate and BLOCO 3 promotion

interpretation_policy.rule: CONHECER UM OBJETO OU SISTEMA NÃO SIGNIFICA POSSUIR ACESSO, CONTROLE, ESTADO AO VIVO OU AUTORIZAÇÃO PARA OPERÁ-LO

everyday_technology_catalog.truthfulness_note: 1B are deterministic addressable representations across objects, systems, functions, uses, risks, states and contexts; not 1B independent technical facts, devices, recipes, programs or files

block_12_self_model.source_of_truth: core/self_model.py for self representation; official identity remains core/star_identity.py
block_12_self_model.database: star.db through BLOCO 3 for materialized canonical self knowledge; runtime registries remain bounded in memory/views
block_12_self_model.knowledge_graph_taxonomy: SELF MODEL -> domínio -> ramo -> subtema; root explicitly points to official identity, official release source and the conceptual B01 Self Model using the shared Knowledge Graph
block_12_self_model.canonical_policy: dynamic self state, permissions, resource snapshots and history are not automatically canonical; persistent B12 self knowledge requires the BLOCO 2 CANONICAL fact gate and BLOCO 3 promotion

self_model_catalog.truthfulness_note: 1B are deterministic addressable self representations across time, source, status, relation, confidence, context and evolution; not 1B fabricated memories, experiences, identities or system states

block_13_memory_continuity.database: same star.db through existing cognitive_memory plus BLOCO 3 for canonical memory knowledge

memory_catalog.truthfulness_note: 1B are deterministic addressable memory/context/retrieval/consolidation representations, not 1B fabricated memories or physical database rows

attention_catalog.truthfulness_note: 1B are deterministic addressable attention/salience states, not 1B simultaneously loaded candidates

block_15_internal_models.cooperation: SITUATION MODEL receives bounded references/context from WORLD, HUMAN, SOCIAL and SELF plus B13/B14; all remain parts of one STAR

model_catalog.truthfulness_note: 5B are virtual model representations over shared sources; not 5B copied facts, memories or database rows

cognitive_catalog.truthfulness_note: 15M are deterministic operational/cognitive support variations, not 15M independently researched facts

persistence.document_search: SQLite FTS5/BM25 when available; textual fallback otherwise
persistence.universal_search: canonical/alias/facet indexes + SQLite FTS5/BM25 when available + bounded invalidatable cache
persistence.physical_world_scene: transient in-memory state; no new persistence table and no automatic promotion to canonical knowledge
persistence.scientific_foundations: no new table; canonical science persists through universal_knowledge and science taxonomy/relations use the existing knowledge graph
persistence.human_life_foundations: no new table; canonical B06 knowledge persists through universal_knowledge, taxonomy/relations use the shared Knowledge Graph, and physiological needs remain non-diagnostic without automatic personal health profiles
persistence.human_psychology_foundations: no new table; canonical B07 knowledge persists through universal_knowledge, taxonomy/relations use the shared Knowledge Graph, and behavior interpretation remains inferential/non-diagnostic without automatic psychological profiles
persistence.language_communication_foundations: no new table; canonical B08 knowledge persists through universal_knowledge, taxonomy/relations use the shared Knowledge Graph, and operational translation/localization continues through the existing LanguageManager
persistence.society_culture_foundations: no new table; canonical B09 knowledge persists through universal_knowledge, taxonomy/relations use the shared Knowledge Graph, and multidisciplinary social references remain non-canonical until the existing B02/B03 gate is satisfied
persistence.human_context_foundations: no new table; canonical B10 knowledge persists through universal_knowledge, taxonomy/relations use the shared Knowledge Graph, and contextual interpretation remains inferential without automatic capacity judgments or action authorization
persistence.everyday_technology_foundations: no new table; canonical B11 knowledge persists through universal_knowledge, taxonomy/relations use the shared Knowledge Graph, and situational technical interpretation does not imply live state, access or operational authorization
persistence.self_model: no new table; canonical B12 self knowledge persists through universal_knowledge and the shared Knowledge Graph; runtime Capability/Limitation/Permission registries, Self State views and bounded Self History remain non-canonical unless explicitly promoted through B02/B03
persistence.memory_continuity: no parallel memory database/table; B13 extends the existing cognitive_memory store, uses a bounded transient working buffer, and stores memory relations/consolidation provenance in the shared Knowledge Graph; canonical memory knowledge still requires B02/B03
persistence.attention_salience: no new table; B14 state is bounded/transient, reuses B13 working memory and StarState, and uses the shared Knowledge Graph only for taxonomy/relations
persistence.internal_models: no new table or duplicated model store; B15 delegates runtime frames to B01 CognitiveModels, references B04-B14 sources and uses the shared Knowledge Graph for taxonomy/relations
